<a id="room19_frame"></a>
### [`room19_frame`](../../../src/ending_room.asm#L27) `$4272`

*routine*

Room 19 frame handler. While title_countdown runs: random colours on screen rows 17-24, columns 4-32, and message 4 ('** CONGRATULATIONS **') at text line 0, column 10. When the countdown is 0, the next game loop starts: game_loop_count + 1, the room 13 bonus flags (room13_band_bonus) of the current player set again, lantern counts (reset_lantern_counts) and lanterns (reset_all_lanterns) reset, per-player room flags (reset_unvisited_rooms) reset, and Bruce goes to the start of room 0 (place_bruce_at_room_start).

- **Jumped to from:** [`run_room_frame_handler`](passage_open.md#run_room_frame_handler) [`$3A7B`](../../../src/passage_open.asm#L26)
- **Entry of:** [`room_frame_handlers`](../tables.md#room_frame_handlers)
- **Calls:** [`reset_lantern_counts`](game_setup.md#reset_lantern_counts), [`reset_all_lanterns`](lantern_pickup.md#reset_all_lanterns), [`reset_unvisited_rooms`](game_setup.md#reset_unvisited_rooms), [`place_bruce_at_room_start`](room_misc_support.md#place_bruce_at_room_start), [`random_byte`](interrupt_entry.md#random_byte), [`print_message`](actor_driver_text.md#print_message)
- **Reads:** [`title_countdown`](../variables.md#title_countdown), [`title_countdown+1`](../variables.md#title_countdown), [`game_loop_count`](../variables.md#game_loop_count), [`current_player`](../variables.md#current_player)
- **Writes:** [`game_loop_count`](../variables.md#game_loop_count), [`RANDOM+1708`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1709`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1748`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1749`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1788`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1789`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1828`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1829`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1868`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1869`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1908`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1909`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1948`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1949`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1988`](../variables.md#RANDOM), [`RANDOM+1989`](../variables.md#RANDOM)
- **Refers to:** [`title_countdown`](../variables.md#title_countdown), [`room13_band_bonus`](../variables.md#room13_band_bonus)
